title: Provenance
description: Where a record came from in the working DXF. Mandatory on every NDJ entity and on every piece of evidence (CLAUDE.md rule 6). `(file, handle)` is the same key in the viewer and in the engine because both parse the same working-DXF bytes (ADR-0002).

file.description: Identifier of the working DXF: either the ULID of the `drawing_file` row or the lowercase sha256 of the original file bytes.

path.description: INSERT chain from the top-level owner down to (but not including) `handle`. Empty for an entity that sits directly in model or paper space.

role.description: Optional role this record plays for the consumer, e.g. `centerline`, `tag_text`, `boundary`.
